14 musings of unusual morning!

June 18, 2006
  1. Mind has declared a war with heart. I am tired.
  2. Brazil sucks. I have switched over, as an Argentina fan for this world cup.
  3. “No - music - mornings” are not worth waking up to.
  4. Hot shower is effective temperory solution to all permanent problems of life. Atleast it gets you through the morning.
  5. Sometimes, anything that can hug you back is worth knowing in life.
  6. My roommate is back. So I have lost my “freedom of small things” again.
  7. Life is miserable again, though for different reasons altogether, this time.
  8. I am depressed once again and somehow I am loving it.
  9. I have turned into a shrewd cold blooded carnivore.
  10. When you hold the helm of ship, you’ll have to bear the turbulence of sea.
  11. Even god did not do it all, in one day, what makes me think, I can. Patience…
  12. Right now I am missing something/someone, that I can hold and let myself out. Weekend has left pile of grudges and hate for life.
  13. Hey God! ….
  14. May god bless my insane soul!

Extract from “Speed Of Sound” By “ColdPlay”
How long before I get in
Before it starts before I begin
How long before you decide or
Before I know what it feels like
Where to, where do I go?
If you never try then you’ll never know
How long do I have to climb
Up on the side of this mountain of mine
